sections.title: What people usually want to know.
sections.intro: Clear answers, without hiding product limits or control choices.
body: Connection Freedom is the product doctrine behind Konn3ct: remove unnecessary barriers to joining, participating, gathering, communicating, controlling and creating value while preserving trust, privacy and legitimate human authority.

No. Meetings are a core experience, but Konn3ct is designed across webinars, events, recording and replay, AI and language assistance, monetisation, organisation administration and mobile participation.

Konn3ct’s target experience includes network monitoring, lower-bandwidth media behaviour, Audio Only fallback and reconnect/recovery states so that the product can protect the conversation when conditions deteriorate.

faqs.a: Connection Freedom is the product doctrine behind Konn3ct: remove unnecessary barriers to joining, participating, gathering, communicating, controlling and creating value while preserving trust, privacy and legitimate human authority.

faqs.q: Is Konn3ct only a meeting platform?
faqs.a: No. Meetings are a core experience, but Konn3ct is designed across webinars, events, recording and replay, AI and language assistance, monetisation, organisation administration and mobile participation.

Konn3ct’s target experience includes network monitoring, lower-bandwidth media behaviour, Audio Only fallback and reconnect/recovery states so that the product can protect the conversation when conditions deteriorate.

AI is designed as an assistive layer for capabilities such as captions, summaries, actions, support and language assistance. Human approval, customer policy, privacy choices and accountability remain visible.

faqs.q: Can organisations control how Konn3ct is used?
faqs.a: Yes. The product direction includes role-based access, host controls, waiting rooms, room locks, recording and AI policies, retention, auditability and enterprise/sovereign deployment options.
